'''J0-N0''' was an [[8D smelter droid]] who worked for [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. J0-N0 hacked into [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] memories so he could obtain the blue prints for the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] for Bane's plan to [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|invade the senate]]. After they successfully obtained the blueprints, Bane wiped the two droids' memories and dumped them back on the streets of the [[Lower market districts/Legends|lower market districts]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
J0-N0's design was based off [[8D8/Legends|8D8]] from [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. J0-N0 was voiced by [[Corey Burton]], who also voiced [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|HELIOS-3E]] in the same episode.
